summary: A parent workflow gets stuck after reset if a child workflow completes after the parent has already failed/closed. The child completion event is lost because the parent was closed when the event arrived, and reset does not synthesize the missing completion.
userImpact: Parent workflows hang indefinitely after reset when a child has completed after the parent failed, blocking progress and requiring manual intervention.
rootCause: Child completion is reported to an already-closed parent, causing the event to be dropped. Reset rebuilds from parent history only, missing the completion event entirely.
keyQuote: The child close transfer task appears to report completion to the parent while the parent is already closed, so the completion is effectively dropped.
